question: After twenty passes your trash plays every beat, with the bounce small (boxed frames 1 to 4). The six-story bar still reads 2 of 6. Close it on your trash, keep going behind the video speed work, or keep going now?
context: Pass 20 gave things that pop in a margin from the frame edge and asked for bigger shakes and repeated beats. Two runs on today's build: bell 7.67 and 7.67, checkbox 7.11 and 7.22 now read as asked every time; heart 6.67 and 4.89, rocket 4.67 and 5.33, your trash 5.0 and 4.22, envelope 3.78 and 3.89. The boxed frames are your exact sentence made in the app today; the reel is 2026-11-14-story-trash-pass20-two-laps.gif.

options.label: Close it on your trash
options.summary: The task ends. Your trash sentence plays every beat as in the picture, with a small bounce. Story icons stay as they are now.
pros: Frees the loop for the video speed focus after twenty passes
What you first asked for, an animated icon instead of a still, works every time
cons: The bounce stays small and easy to miss
Four of six test stories still read below 7
options.mitigation: If a story icon disappoints later, say so and it comes back as a new task with that example.

options.label: Keep going, behind video speed
options.summary: The task stays open but waits behind the video speed work, so the loop comes back to the bounce and the other stories only when nothing more important is waiting.
pros: The video focus is not held up
The story work is not thrown away
cons: It may be days before the next pass
The score has sat at 1 or 2 of six for eleven passes
options.mitigation: Each pass still ends with a reel of your trash in front of you.

options.label: Keep going now, ahead of everything
options.summary: More passes right away, about two hours each, each read on two runs of the six stories.
pros: Aims straight at the bar you set
This pass moved the bell and the checkbox above 7 to stay
cons: Holds the video speed focus back
Eleven passes have not reached 3 of six
options.mitigation: Each pass ends with the reel, so you can stop it at any point.
